results.title: Sustainable Fisheries | NOAA Fisheries
results.content: A **.gov** website belongs to an official government organization in the United States. U.S. fisheries are big business, providing jobs and recreation and keeping our coastal communities vibrant. In fact, the United States is a global leader in responsibly managed fisheries and sustainable seafood. Working closely with commercial, recreational, and small-scale tribal fishermen, we have rebuilt numerous fish stocks and managed to create some of the most sustainably managed fisheries in the world. Managing sustainable fisheries is a dynamic process that requires constant and routine attention to new scientific information that can guide management actions. Learn more about the sustainable management of our marine fisheries. More formally known as the Report to Congress on the Status of U.S. Fisheries, this annual report provides a ‘snapshot’ in time of the status of U.S. fisheries showing the results of the combined efforts of NOAA Fisheries, regional fishery management councils, and other partners to end overfishing under the MSA. Learn more about fisheries management in the United States.
